page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores and 8 threads. System memory totals 31.0 GB RAM, providing approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is supplied by an onboard NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of Turing-generation VRAM. The configuration includes no local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluation reveals modest host CPU throughput paired with strong GPU inference processing. The system recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0, a multi-core score of 3617.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 7041.46. Memory bandwidth testing shows large-block sequential read speeds of 39.4 GB/sec and write speeds of 36.26 GB/sec. In machine learning inference evaluations, the NVIDIA T4 GPU demonstrates high efficiency, reaching prompt processing throughput of 8407.18 tokens per second on 135M parameter models and 1134.43 tokens per second on 7B parameter models, alongside a 7B text generation rate of 33.96 tokens per second.

The hardware balance presents distinct architectural tradeoffs. The relatively low scores across general-purpose metrics, such as Redis operations and static web serving, indicate that the host CPU is not tailored for heavy CPU-bound computation or high-throughput transaction databases. Instead, the combination of 8 dedicated vCPUs, 31.0 GB system RAM, and a 16 GB T4 GPU delivers a cost-efficient profile for deep learning model inference, image recognition, and batch media transcoding workloads that do not depend on fast local scratch disks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for inference and media processing workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz with 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, paired with 31.0 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance includes 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and no local storage, requiring network-attached cloud disks. Benchmark metrics highlight strong prompt processing performance for small and medium language models, delivering 1134.43 tokens per second on 7B models. Conversely, CPU-bound synthetic tests and memory caching yield modest results, reflected in a PassMark CPU score of 7041.46. Consequently, this server is best suited for small-to-medium deep learning inference, image processing, and lightweight transcoding tasks.
